column5: 58 cases of the L0 text iteration, editing and UTF-8 reading (cx/text): tx_iter_init, tx_split_next (empty pieces kept), tx_line_next (LF and CRLF), tx_replace (too small leaves the destination untouched, overlap refused), tx_lower, tx_upper, tx_ieq, tx_utf8_valid and tx_utf8_next (overlong, surrogate and out-of-range refused).
